data.summary: Beispiel Energie AG wrote on 28 October 2025 that electricity prices rise on 1 January 2026. The monthly advance payment (Abschlag) goes from €72.00 to €81.00.
data.explanation: Your electricity provider is raising its prices because of higher grid fees and procurement costs. The price per kWh goes up, the base fee goes up, and your monthly advance payment rises by €9.00. You have a special right to cancel the contract without a notice period, effective when the price change takes effect (§ 41 Abs. 5 EnWG). Cancellation must be in text form (e.g. e-mail). You can decide whether to cancel or switch provider; the app shows until when this right applies. If you do nothing, the new prices apply.
